body: These free public series lead quarterly results, usually by 1–3 months. Autos: Vahan dashboard (daily registrations), FADA monthly retail and dealer inventory, SIAM monthly wholesales, tractor sales. Banks and NBFCs: RBI fortnightly credit and deposit data, RBI monthly sectoral deployment and NBFC credit release, CRIF/CIBIL delinquency, MFIN Micrometer, CP/NCD spreads. Capital markets: AMFI monthly note (AUM, SIP, folios), NSE/BSE monthly turnover, CDSL/NSDL accounts. Power: Grid-India daily PSP report (peak demand), CEA monthly generation and daily coal stock, IEX daily prices, MNRE capacity. Cement and steel: eight core industries index (monthly), JPC steel consumption, dealer price checks, China NBS exports, SGX iron ore. Capex: CGA monthly central capex, RBI OBICUS utilisation, IIP capital goods, CMIE project announcements. Consumption: GST collections (monthly, 1st of the month), NielsenIQ quarterly FMCG, CPI food, RBI consumer confidence, credit card spends, e-way bills. Real estate: ANAROCK/PropEquity quarterly, Knight Frank Mumbai registrations. Pharma: USFDA warning letters, 483s and import alerts, AIOCD monthly IPM growth. Defence: PIB DAC AoN releases and MoD contract signings. IT: Accenture results, which come about 3 weeks earlier, plus Naukri JobSpeak. Trap: mixing wholesale and retail, and failing to adjust for festival-calendar shifts. Oct 2026 FADA retail fell 14–28% only because Diwali moved into November, while SIAM wholesale rose 12–16%.

data.example_nov_2026: Oct 2026: SIAM PV +12.4%, 2W +16.1% vs FADA PV −14.2%, 2W −28.4% (Diwali shift).
data.lesson: Track one leading series per sector you own; always compare retail vs wholesale and adjust for calendar shifts.

title: India sector lead-indicator dashboard: public data sources
